name: Image to Image AI — Tancky AI
tagline: Browser image-to-image editing with text-controlled changes
description: An uploaded photo provides the starting point for edits. A text prompt specifies changes to style, background or outfit; Tancky AI is designed to help retain faces, products and composition while making those changes. This workflow runs in the browser without installation or a GPU. Tools for background removal, upscaling, old-photo restoration and image combining are also available. The interface is offered in English and Chinese, and new accounts receive free trial credits. Paid output is watermark-free; commercial use is available when you have rights to the source photo.
